channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Sycuan Band opens new tribal health center on reservation in Dehesa
item.description: The Sycuan Band of the Kumeyaay Nation has opened a state-of-the art health center on the reservation in Dehesa.

item.title: Opinion: What’s in a name? Everything if the name is ‘Trump’
item.description: President Trump is putting his name on much of the nation's capital. Maybe renaming NATO after Trump would ensure the alliance prospers.

item.title: Underdog SDSU, with backup QB at the reins, set to clash with North Texas in New Mexico Bowl
item.description: The Aztecs (9-3) take on North Texas in Albuquerque at 2:45 p.m. Saturday. SDSU will be without starting QB Jayden Denegal.

item.title: Woman who died by suicide in Little Italy had been sentenced to prison for murder scheme
item.description: The San Diego County Medical Examiner's Office said that Tatyana Remley, 45, shot herself in a public square just before 9 p.m. Thursday.

item.title: Judge blocks statewide policy that kept teachers from sharing gender identity
item.description: U.S. District Judge Roger Benitez granted summary judgment in the case, originally filed by two Escondido teachers from Rincon Middle School.

item.title: Sex trafficking sting in San Diego County frees 19 victims, leads to 10 Arrests
item.description: Operation Home for the Holidays was conducted over a three-day period and involved undercover officers posing as sex buyers.

item.title: Pirates snap up Padres free agent Ryan O’Hearn with $29 million contract
item.description: The Pittsburgh Pirates took a step toward being a contender in 2026, agreeing to a two-year contract with Padres first baseman/outfielder Ryan O'Hearn.

item.title: SD Sheriff’s Crime Lab receives $585K grant to combat impaired driving
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that its Regional Crime Laboratory has received a $585,000 state grant to aid in its continuing efforts to combat impaired driving.

item.title: SDG&E offers tips to stay safe as winter storm approaches San Diego County
item.description: San Diego Gas & Electric said Tuesday it was taking proactive steps to prepare for an approaching winter storm, pledging to prioritize public safety, minimize outages and ensure crews are ready to respond quickly to severe weather conditions.

item.title: Some SD County beaches face water contact restrictions this holiday week
item.description: Beaches near the Tijuana Slough and a storm drain in South Mission Beach were ordered closed Tuesday by the San Diego County Department of Environmental Health and Quality because of high bacteria levels.
